name: dumbbell glute dominant step up
description: A step-up with a forward lean and a high box that shifts the work onto the glutes.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and face a bench or box.
Place one foot fully on the box and lean your torso slightly forward.
Push through the heel of that foot to stand up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
